pick.headline: Israeli ambassador Shlomo Argov shot in London
pick.fbis: The Middle East & South Asia review of June 4, 1982, reported Jerusalem radio on Argov shot in the head in London, Shamir blaming Arab terrorists, and a PLO denial; Shamir also called for the PLO's 'final liquidation'.

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: Middle East & Africa, Vol. V No. 108, 4 June 1982

alternates.headline: Ayatollah Khomeyni dies
alternates.fbis: The Near East & South Asia Daily Report of June 7, 1989, carried a KUNA interview in which Arafat, discussing the intifada, wished the Iranian leadership success in overcoming problems after the passing of Ayatollah Khomeyni.

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: Near East & South Asia, No. 108, 7 June 1989
